heading: EXT. CHURCH BELFRY, HOLLOWED VILLAGE - DAY

units.text: EXT. CHURCH BELFRY, HOLLOWED VILLAGE - DAY
A shattered belfry overlooking a flooded field.
A stagnant afternoon.
Rain has stopped but the sky has not made up its mind.

SERGEANT NIKOLAI VASSILIEV (30s, tired, frost in his beard) sits on an ammunition crate, cleaning a rifle bolt with a rag, while PRIVATE ANNELIESE BRANDSTETTER (20s, a nurse's armband stitched crooked over her sleeve) rewraps a bandage and a fresh-faced boy, PRIVATE YUSUF DEMIR (19), watches the field through a gap in the stones and a radioman, CORPORAL HARLAN PIKE (40s, headset askew), lights a cigarette, drags on it, hands it to Yusuf, and takes the binoculars back without looking.
A scrap of white cloth drifts across the flooded field, snagged on a pole that bobs and turns in the current.
Beneath it, something pale struggles in the water.
Hold your fire. Let it come.
units.name: SERGEANT

units.text: It's a dog, Sergeant.
units.name: YUSUF

units.text: It's a dog with a cloth round its neck. Wait.
units.name: NIKOLAI

units.text: It's limping.
units.name: ANNELIESE

units.text: Could be a trick.
units.name: PIKE

units.text: Could be a leg.
units.name: ANNELIESE

units.text: The dog stumbles in the water.
Anneliese rises, but Nikolai catches her sleeve.
Wait.
units.name: NIKOLAI

units.text: She waits.
Pike mutters into the handset, lowers it, and shrugs.
Yusuf passes the cigarette back.
Nikolai sets his rifle bolt on the crate, wipes his hands, and nods once.
Go and get it.
units.name: NIKOLAI

units.text: Anneliese and Yusuf start down the stone steps together.
Pike watches them go.
Nikolai goes back to the bolt.
You'd have let it drown.
units.name: PIKE

units.text: I'd have let it choose.
units.name: SERGEANT

units.text: He slides the bolt home.
It clicks.
